summary: The catalog entry is under the correct parent, renders into the controller ConfigMap, meets KubeCoder's toolchain contract (memory limit, no command/args), and names the image ArgoCDTools actually publishes on a floating tag; the 1Gi sizing and the omitted skipParityChecks/homeOverlays check out against live pod state and the shipped generator. Two advisory prose inaccuracies in the new comment block, neither affecting behaviour.

findings.summary: The entry's "every first-party image in this catalog floats" is contradicted by the block header and four pinned entries in the same file.
The instructions tell agents no repo needs a copy of arch-validate, while HelmCharts' own Jenkinsfile.architecture still runs scripts/arch-validate.py and retiring the copies is ANS-78.
